# Ask Janice

> Ask Janice is an AI receptionist for local businesses. It answers your calls 24/7, sounds like a real receptionist, captures every lead, and books appointments straight into your calendar.

Ask Janice also includes a live chat bot for your website, SMS follow-up, call transfers, and calendar booking. One plan: $49/mo, unlimited calls, no contracts.
